people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
translations.bsb: We are fools for Christ, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are honored, but we are dishonored.
translations.kjv: We are fools for ➔ Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.
translations.asv: We are fools for Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye have glory, but we have dishonor.
